summary: Iteration 4 (sign-in + policy editor + presenter notes). Backend: rewrote /app/backend/tests/test_leash_api.py to send Clerk bearer tokens and added 41 pytest cases covering public endpoints (health, clerk/config, shared), anon 401 on all secured routes, pending 403 (and /api/me 200), member 200 on purchases but 403 on /users & PATCH role, admin GET /users shape and role list, PATCH unknown-role rejected 403, pending->member->pending round-trip (verified via GET), single-admin demote 409 (admin restored verified), plus policy-validation 422s, legacy 404/422/share/export/extract. All 41 pass in ~16s. Frontend: signed-out /app, /app/purchases/x, /app/compare and /app/team all redirect to /sign-in; landing page and share links stay public. Sign-in card renders at 1920 and 450 widths with 'Continue with Google' readable (Development-mode footer shown; Clerk dev-keys warning only). Member flow: /app shows purchases list + New purchase panel, user-menu present, nav-team hidden, /app/team redirects to /app. Policy editor defaults 5000/25000, reset button appears on change and restores defaults, empty or 0 limit shows policy-error AND disables start-run-btn. Admin flow: Team page lists exactly the three test users with role selects; 'Let in' flips pending->member (verified via select value), setting back to pending works. Pending flow: /app and /app/team both show pending-access gate with the correct email and no purchases/nav. Presenter notes: toggling on shows 8 'Say' notes under each chapter; the setting persists in localStorage ('leash-presenter-notes'); pressing N toggles; number keys still jump chapters. Shared /share/{token} page (signed-out): no presenter-notes-toggle, no notes, no nav-purchases/nav-team/export/share/user-menu, read-only badge present, full timeline renders. Export: authenticated fetch -> blob download produced leash-purchase-10.json. Share: create -> URL returned, turn-off works (verified via curl 404 afterwards). Compare: 'Spending limit · cash reserve' row rendered and marked 'differs' (10,000.00 · 20,000.00 vs 5,000.00 · 25,000.00). Old purchases without policy/started_by open fine in Compare and the purchase page (header hides the policy chip when run.policy is null). I did NOT run a fresh real purchase because the existing runs already exercise every piece the briefing calls out (purchase-policy header, authenticated download, share flow); the live-stream-via-fetch change is covered structurally by the 401 test on /api/runs/{id}/stream and by the member-token purchases-ok test. Suggest the main agent self-verifies a single live run if desired.

issues: Clerk development-mode footer bar overlaps the lower edge of the sign-in card at both 1920 and 450 widths; purely a dev-instance artefact, not a code bug.
Spending-policy number inputs sit comfortably in the panel at 1920; no overflow observed. OK.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py current_member: on the very first sign-in of a non-admin user the inner update_one({role:{$in:[None,'']}}) sets role=DEFAULT_ROLE and the following find_one_and_update's $setOnInsert will be a no-op; safe for new users and idempotent for repeat sign-ins. Looks correct.

server.py RANK gate in set_role: because admin has the highest RANK, member-admin demote-only-admin logic is fine, but the 'role you do not know' rule is enforced by the same if; pytest confirms unknown 'superuser' returns 403.

server.py /api/runs/{id}/stream continues to use StreamingResponse + text/event-stream but the client now reads it with fetch + Authorization. Verified structurally; a real live run would exercise progressive rendering but was not run here to respect the single-run-at-a-time constraint and to avoid reloading uvicorn with test file edits during a live run.
SceneRail: note the 'n' keyboard handler fires even when the toggle is not on; harmless but could be gated by onNotes presence (already is).
Protected.jsx renders null while me is being fetched; this briefly hides the chrome between Clerk sign-in and /api/me completion — acceptable.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on tested flows (access control, policy editor, presenter notes, team page, pending gate, shared view, export, share, compare)

test_credentials: Clerk preview users via /app/memory/clerk_test_users.py (admin/member/pending at leash.{role}+clerk_test@example.com). Use 'python clerk_test_users.py ticket <role>' for UI sign-in (single-use, 10 min) or 'token' for API bearer. ADMIN_EMAIL sourced from backend/.env.
seed_data_creation: No new runs created. Temporarily toggled Test Pending user's role to member and back to pending; toggled share_token on run 046bf397fdda on and back off. End state: admin=admin, member=member, pending=pending; no active share tokens left on.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Live-run of a real purchase from the UI (member, limit=5000, reserve=24000) was NOT re-executed in this iteration; the briefing says the main agent already verified the policy.py fix with real runs, and the auth+fetch stream pieces are already covered. If a future testing agent wants to redo it, note: (1) tickets are single use, fetch a fresh one before each sign-in; (2) backend uvicorn --reload: do not create/edit any /app/backend file while a run is live; (3) use PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 -p no:cacheprovider; (4) Clerk's hidden checkbox for presenter notes requires clicking the wrapping label, not the input; (5) purchases list has visually hidden pick checkboxes inside .pick labels. Three test users must remain in Mongo; do not delete.
